Empirical_Evidence: Raw yield is severely right-skewed (+3.74); log1p transformation reduces skewness to -0.10.
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Evaluating with MSE will over-penalize high-yield crops. Explore log-target regression in Phase 4.

Empirical_Evidence: Sugarcane median (5,200 kg/ha) is 24x higher than Cotton (212.5 kg/ha).
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Global outlier thresholds are invalid. Outlier detection must be crop-stratified.

Empirical_Evidence: Chickpea yields > 30,000 kg/ha in Bihar (2007) are impossible data-entry errors.
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Implement training-set outlier trimming to prevent gradient corruption.

Empirical_Evidence: Fertilizer = Nitrogen + Phosphorus + Potassium across 100.00% of observations (|diff| < 0.21).
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Drop Fertilizer or evaluate multicollinearity in feature selection to prevent infinite VIF.

Empirical_Evidence: Pesticide has zero within-year variance; acts as a 1D national step function correlated with Year (r = -0.76).
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Pesticide provides no district-level management signal; evaluate for elimination in feature selection.

Empirical_Evidence: Bivariate linear correlation with Rainfall is ~0, but binned crop-specific responses show clear optima.
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Linear models will fail without Crop x Climate interaction terms; tree models will capture non-linearities.

Empirical_Evidence: Green Revolution cereals (Wheat, Rice) experienced >300% yield growth from 1966 to 2017.
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Strict chronological out-of-time evaluation (Train <=2011, Val 2012-2014, Test 2015-2017) is mandatory.

Empirical_Evidence: Crop and Season exhibit a block-diagonal 1-to-1 mapping. Every crop belongs to exactly 1 season.
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Season is completely collinear with Crop; one-hot encoding both creates redundant degrees of freedom.

Empirical_Evidence: pH is strictly bounded (5.6 - 8.0) and has tiny variance within USDA Soil Orders (std 0.12 - 0.35).
ML_Pipeline_Implication: pH likely derived from soil taxonomy; test whether it adds value beyond Soil Type.

Empirical_Evidence: Weather and nutrient variables are contemporaneous post-planting observations.
ML_Pipeline_Implication: Classify models as scenario-based yield predictors rather than pre-season forecasts.
